selected_candidate: NAVER CLOVA CORD-v2 full-receipt hierarchical parsing
different_task: Indonesian photographed retail/restaurant receipts -> released hierarchical JSON fields; not macroeconomic charts, Treasury tables, or generic COCO captions
project_scoped_prior_route_search: No clovaai/cord or cord-v2 matches found in coordination/tasks, analysis/bw1000, code/bw1000 at research time; this is not a whole-disk search

publisher_and_authorship.publisher: Clova AI, NAVER Corp.; official naver-clova-ix dataset account
publisher_and_authorship.paper: CORD: A Consolidated Receipt Dataset for Post-OCR Parsing, 2019 Document Intelligence Workshop at NeurIPS
publisher_and_authorship.packaging_version_caveat: dataset_infos reports 0.0.0; do not confuse this packaging field with the semantic CORD v2 release

rights.primary_basis: Official dataset repository LICENSE-CC-BY and release-wide statement, official naver-clova-ix/cord-v2 card and dataset_infos, not a third-party mirror or code-only license
rights.released_images_and_annotations: The publisher describes the release as receipt images plus OCR/semantic annotations and labels the released work CC BY4. This supports adaptation/training of released material subject to attribution and license conditions; it does not grant access to unreleased collection material
rights.attribution: Preserve CORD title/authors/NAVER CLOVA, original dataset and license links, version/source hashes and every preprocessing/annotation change notice
rights.removed_fields_boundary: Publisher removed store_info, payment_info and etc targets following Indonesian legal issues. Use only the released v2 gt_parse; do not reconstruct those removed classes, omitted identities or private 11k collection

publisher_inventory_metadata_observed.private_collection_not_released_scope: over 11000 mentioned by publisher; not available training inventory
publisher_inventory_metadata_observed.official_tree_total_rounded: 2.31 GB, four train Parquet files plus validation and test Parquet
publisher_inventory_metadata_observed.byte_count_status: publisher advertised metadata, not independently downloaded/file-hashed
publisher_inventory_metadata_observed.representative_sample_evidence: Official HF train preview exposes image plus nonempty gt_parse menu/sub_total/total hierarchy and training meta identity; no raw answer/image is copied into this public proposal
publisher_inventory_metadata_observed.fixed_revision_raw_metadata_web_open: The commit page was reachable; opening raw dataset_infos at that revision was unavailable through the web tool. Main metadata was readable. No claim of fixed raw SHA or per-row acquisition success

minimum_comparable_design.split_source: Preserve official train/validation/test respectively; no official test used as train or calibration
minimum_comparable_design.planned_slot_rule: Within each official split, rank ordinal 0..N-1 by SHA256(seed + ':' + immutable_revision + ':' + split + ':' + ordinal), take 32/16/16 before inspecting annotations/images/model results. Ordinals are planned slots, not invented actual image_ids. Actual row/image_id/media SHA mapping must be independently frozen after bounded staging
minimum_comparable_design.sampling_exclusions: No selection by answer presence/value, OCR ease, image clarity, token length or generated quality; missing/corrupt/duplicate/overlength slots retain failure and are not backfilled
minimum_comparable_design.source_group: One original receipt remains one group with its complete released gt_parse; no field/question fragments cross splits
minimum_comparable_design.content_dedup_pending: Future custodian must hash actual media and predeclared near-duplicate fingerprints across all64 selected receipts and project hash-only inventories; cross-split collision retains all affected slots as failure. No actual media was inspected for this proposal
minimum_comparable_design.merchant_generalization_limit: A reliable merchant/source-group ID is not provided by the observed public schema and relevant identity targets were removed. Official split plus media dedup cannot prove merchant/template-disjointness; do not claim unseen-merchant generalization or reconstruct removed store fields
minimum_comparable_design.representation_limit: Only Indonesian photographed receipts from the released sample. Fixed random slots do not guarantee every shop type, language condition or layout. Report train/dev field/layout coverage after staging; never balance blind labels to make coverage look better

uniform_framework_input_contract.first_provider: current common-framework native qwen3_vl template/processor/collator; later other four VLM native-HF providers under their own frozen template and recipe
uniform_framework_input_contract.input: One complete original receipt image plus fixed answer-free extraction instruction; no OCR transcripts, ground_truth, boxes or gold fields supplied as user input
uniform_framework_input_contract.train_supervision: Original released gt_parse serialized as canonical JSON after FINAL: in assistant turn; preserve all released fields, strings, hierarchy and item multiplicity, with an explicit reversible formatting change record
uniform_framework_input_contract.dev_blind_gold: Separate scoring custody, never uploaded to model inputs or train JSONL
uniform_framework_input_contract.full_image_and_tokens: No crop/ROI substitution, omitted fields or silently truncated target. Native model preprocessing policy remains explicit; complete 4096-token template/target and natural EOS supervision must be checked, including image/user/padding masks. Failure is retained rather than shortening the task
uniform_framework_input_contract.generation_eligibility: Only status COMPLETED with strictly typed natural_EOS=true and cap_hit=false may score as correct; missing/rejected/cap/non-EOS/untyped/invalid-JSON failures stay in all planned receipt denominators
uniform_framework_input_contract.formal17: Do not modify original 8card BF16 batch1 accum4 recipes or official references. Any new domain budget/precision/card count/timing creates a separate comparable recipe
uniform_framework_input_contract.model_initialization: Freeze exact base/processor/tokenizer/template/initial LoRA parameters, seed and ordered receipt exposures before training; none qualified for this candidate

task_metrics_not_loss.primary: Field-level micro precision/recall/F1 for complete released hierarchical parse, using frozen publisher JSONParseEvaluator semantics
task_metrics_not_loss.secondary: Mean publisher normalized-tree-edit-distance accuracy max(1-nTED,0), plus exact full-JSON/receipt success and JSON validity
task_metrics_not_loss.denominators: Fixed16 dev and16 blind receipts; invalid/non-EOS/cap/missing receipts receive zero per-receipt success/nTED accuracy and retain all gold fields as false negatives for field recall. Report every failure and full field counts; do not zip/drop missing predictions
task_metrics_not_loss.scorer_status: Official NAVER Donut util.py cal_f1/cal_acc source inspected through primary repository. Exact scorer commit/wholefileSHA/dependencies and malformed-output adapter are not yet frozen or run; no scorer qualification claimed
task_metrics_not_loss.comparison: Pair base and future domain checkpoint on identical frozen dev16, generation constraints and scorer; compare independent generic LoRA only when equal-budget nonleaking control inputs are actually ready. No existing sealed COCO16 route reopened
task_metrics_not_loss.small_sample_limit: 16 receipt dev is engineering/pilot evidence, not official CORD100 test reproduction or broad transfer. Training loss is not receipt parsing ability

next_shortest_real_step_and_blockers.primary_blocker: No bounded immutable-revision path for extracting complete selected image+ground_truth rows has been validated. Official Parquet files are hundreds of MB; do not download full2.31GB or third-party re-encoded mirror to obtain64 slots
next_shortest_real_step_and_blockers.next_action: Root may authorize a separately published metadata-only access claim: establish fixed-revision official per-row or exact Parquet range/row-group byte cost and identity before any media body GET. If source cannot provide bounded complete rows, keep this candidate BLOCKED; no blind-page scouting or alternate-source silent fallback
later_gates: source/media dedup and official split membership
fixed base/initial parameters and equal exposure budget
paired task effect/general-control and blind evaluation
